{{Top}}
'''Republic Day''' was a holiday celebrating the foundation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> characterized by many fireworks and parades, as well as many stores conducting half-price sales, especially on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was celebrated on the nineteenth day of the third month of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]. After the fall of the Republic, it became known as [[Remembrance Day]].
